name: Attention Jolt
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level cleric 1 , inquisitor 1 , sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V, S, M/DF (strand of ally’s hair)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Targets all willing allies, no two of which can be no more than 30 ft. apart
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You send a sudden warning to your allies that quickens their reaction time.

This spell can only be cast before initiative is rolled during a surprise round. All targets of the spell are allowed to act in the surprise round even if they wouldn’t normally be able to do so.

Attention jolt can only be used when the caster is not surprised and is aware of the circumstances triggering the surprise round.
